blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — A homemade 12-gauge shotgun was voluntarily surrendered to the Banayoyo Municipal Police Station (MPS) on Monday, as part of the Philippine National Police’s (PNP) continuing campaign against loose firearms. A barangay official turned over the firearm to Banayoyo MPS personnel led by the officer in charge, Police Major Medward Galay. In a report on Tuesday, police cited the barangay official as saying that the firearm had been handed to him voluntarily by one of his constituents, whose identity he requested to remain confidential.
